answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it earns reputation; the bond is released only after verified work. A public trellis links each identity's bond history to its payouts, while a pigment tag marks reused funding routes for audit. An ivory-colored risk flag can route those accounts to human review. An attacker making 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds and forgo their yield, and risks losing each bond if caught; honest agents recover theirs.
